audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Divine council, elohim, unjust judgment, poor and needy people, gods, mortality, and justice.

verses.restored: God stands in the divine assembly; in the midst of the gods he judges.

familiar.text: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

notes.title: Divine assembly
notes.body: Hebrew elohim appears both for God and for the beings/judges within the divine assembly. The verse preserves an ancient divine-council image rather than flattening every occurrence into the same referent.

modern.text: God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:

original.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט

verses.restored: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

familiar.text: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

modern.text: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah

original.text: עַד מָתַ֥י תִּשְׁפְּטוּ עָ֑וֶל וּפְנֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תִּשְׂאוּ סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

familiar.text: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

modern.text: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.

original.text: שִׁפְטוּ דַ֥ל וְיָת֑וֹם עָנִ֖י וָרָ֣שׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ

verses.restored: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

familiar.text: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

modern.text: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.

original.text: פַּלְּטוּ דַ֥ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מִיַּ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים הַצִּֽילוּ

verses.restored: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

familiar.text: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

modern.text: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

original.text: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: I said, “You are gods, all of you children of the Most High.”

familiar.text: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

notes.title: “You are gods”
notes.body: The address to elohim is debated: divine beings, rulers, or judges have all been proposed. John 10:34 later cites this verse. The original ambiguity remains important.

modern.text: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’

original.text: אֲֽנִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

familiar.text: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

modern.text: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”

original.text: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ

verses.restored: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

familiar.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

modern.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: The psalm’s target is corrupt power. “Gods” language must not be used to dehumanize people or claim unquestionable authority for leaders.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
